description: This file defines a React functional component 'TasksList' that manages and displays a list of user tasks with features such as fetching, adding, updating status, and deleting tasks, integrating with a backend via imported service functions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and updates the task list from the backend, handling loading state and errors.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new task, including input validation, invoking the create service, and updating the task list.

methods.name: onUpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific task with optimistic UI updates and error handling.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specific task with optimistic UI removal and error handling.
